children: MongoDB, Inc. reported results for the quarter ended 2026 with revenue of $771.77M and diluted earnings per share of $0.5, versus $591.4M and ($0.58) in the prior-year quarter, reflecting accelerating subscription growth and a return to profitability.
¹ Reported as “Total revenue”. ² Reported as “Net income (loss)”. ³ Reported as “Net income (loss) per share”.
Revenue growth was driven by Atlas consumption and expansion in enterprise customers, with subscription revenue up roughly 30% year over year.
Customer base expanded to more than 70,600 customers, including over 69,300 Atlas customers and 2,999 customers with at least $100k ARR.
Shift toward Atlas usage-billed monthly in arrears continued versus upfront term licenses, increasing hosted consumption and related hosting costs but improving scale efficiencies.
Ongoing R&D investment prioritized AI features, Atlas Search/Vector/Searchable APIs and MongoDB 8.0 enhancements to sustain product leadership.
Company maintained investments in sales, marketing and services while managing hosting cost growth as Atlas usage scaled.
